title: Just finished the ability kit and animations for Zafira, my new Mage character. Would love some feedback!
author: Final_Huckleberry408
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to share the latest character I’ve been developing for my game: **Zafira**

Fun story about the creation process—I actually let Claude (AI) take the reins on this one! My only requirement was that it had to be a Mage. Honestly, it turned out to be one of the best character concepts I've gotten so far. The ability kit feels incredibly balanced, and the animations are coming together beautifully.

I’m really happy with how Zafira's visual identity and gameplay style vibe together.

I’d love to hear your thoughts! How do the animations look to you? Does the kit feel like something you'd enjoy playing? Any feedback or critique is highly appreciated!

comments.author: AsparagusOk8818
comments.body:
IMHO, the character lacks any real identity. you can't even make out their head and face in the thumbnail image you've provided

in terms of the featured gameplay, there is no expressiveness to her movement - a fact that isn't helped by her badly defined sprite

what is the desired player fantasy that Zafira is supposed to embody? she's a mage, okay... how is that expressed by the game and/or the player? Even things that feel like they should be signature moves - her mirror images, for example - are lost in the messy animations and movement. There's no ceremony or celebration to the action

i also seriously question whether your game is currently in such a solid state that the focus ought to be on expanding the character roster. like... you're happy with a brawler whose combat looks like that? you think anyone would wishlist that when they could have Absolum or Streets of Rage or Cosmic Invasion instead?

i don't personally understand why you'd let Claude design a character for a game - that would ruin the joy for me - but i suppose everyone gets something different out of doing this

  
so, in summary: 

 \- The character isn't well defined.  
 \- Her attacks look incredibly lackluster and uninspired  
 \- Her signature moves don't inspire the viewer to want to play with her  
 \- The game, overall, does not look like it has sufficiently solid foundations to begin building extra content on top of
